title: Flowers: The Midnight Bloom
template:
Deep in the moonlit valley, a rare plant begins to wake up under the stars. Unlike ordinary daisies, this flower has [color] petals that shimmer in the darkness. It only opens when the crickets start their nightly song.

Legend says that if you [action] near the blossom, it will glow even brighter. The scent it releases smells like [smell], filling the air with a magical aroma. Many travelers journey for miles just to see this midnight wonder.

When the first light of dawn touches the [location], the flower slowly curls back into a bud. It waits patiently for the sun to set so it can show its beauty once again. Protecting this secret garden is the job of the local [creature].

blanks.hint: a small animal or magical being
